title: Checkout HTTP 500 — payment total mismatch after v2.14.0 rollout
body: Multiple customers report checkout failure with HTTP 500. Error trace shows 'payment total mismatch' in checkout-service after the v2.14.0 deployment. Root cause: discount rounding logic changed in price_calculator.py line 87. Fix merged in hotfix/v2.14.1 — awaiting QA sign-off.
